top_signals.title: Vale Mulls Raising Over $500 Million in Debut Panda Bond Sale
top_signals.summary: Brazilian iron ore giant Vale SA is considering to raise as much as 3.5 billion yuan ($522 million) in its debut issuance in China’s bond market, according to people familiar with the matter, joining a growing number of issuers diversifying funding sources and looking for cheaper options.
